templates: Roofer here, we work {city} and the surrounding suburbs. Happy to tell you what to look for before you call anybody out. Most of what we see around here traces back to hail.
We do {trade} work around {city}. If you want a second opinion on what somebody already told you, ask away. No obligation either way.
Local {trade} crew in the {city} area. Two things worth checking first: the shingle granules in your gutters, and any soft spots in the decking. That usually tells you how serious it is.
We run {trade} jobs across {city} and nearby. Storm season here beats roofs up more than people expect, so if you want somebody to actually look at it rather than guess, we can do that.
Been doing {trade} in {city} a long while. Photos from the ground help, but the real answer is usually up top. Glad to walk you through what we would check.
urgent_templates: If water is coming in right now, get a tarp or a bucket under it first so the ceiling does not go. We do {trade} in {city} and can come look. Do not let it sit through another rain.
Active leak is a different animal than wear. Slow the water down inside first, then get eyes on the roof. We cover {city} for {trade} and can get out there.
That one needs looking at soon. Water finds the framing fast. We are a {trade} crew working {city} and can take a look before it spreads further.
Do not wait on that one. Pull anything valuable out from under the drip and cover what you can. We do {trade} around {city} if you want somebody out to check it.
signoff: Happy to answer questions here either way.
